## Summary

Across 39 gauges the event total ranged from 0.00 to 2.36 in (median 0.08 in). The central 80% of the network-mean rain fell between Sep 23 11:00 MST and Sep 23 15:00 MST (4 h). Moisture transport over Flagstaff stayed below atmospheric-river strength: ERA5 IVT peaked at 68 kg m⁻¹ s⁻¹ from the SW at Sep 23 05:00 MST, and total column water vapour reached 18 mm. At the IVT peak, 500-hPa flow over Flagstaff was from the SW at 9 m s⁻¹, and the 500-hPa trough axis along 35.25°N was at 115.2°W, 327 km west of Flagstaff (5,824 m, against 5,834 m over Flagstaff). A closed 500-hPa low (5,815 m) was centred 1,060 km to the SW, at 28.0°N 119.0°W. The strongest 250-hPa wind within 1,000 km was 49 m s⁻¹, 887 km to the NNE. The 250-hPa wind over Flagstaff peaked at 31 m s⁻¹ (Sep 23 05:00 MST), at the same time as the IVT peak.
